title: PlanIt
tagline: No more scribbled notes, abandoned plans or the never ending search for the perfect restaurant. PLANIT is a one-stop planning tool that allows you to search, make lists, share, and even sell them as NFTs.
description:
This project aims to make planning easier. One can search for places, food items, books, or anything using the search API and add them to create a list. The lists created can be shared with people who can like or dislike the list.
People can search for the best weekend plans or the best breakfast places around the area. As you improve your credentials and visibility, you can even make customized plans for users and sell them as NFT.
how_its_made:
This project uses the Moralis framework, IPFS, Polygon network, and Maps API.

A user can log in using metamask and explore existing plans.

A new plan can be created by searching locations and places using places API which is stored on IPFS.

NFTs are minted on Polygon network. You can create, edit and organise your plans and upvotes plans that are trending at the call of an API
